```day-atom

```

Reproduction of the upstream baseline, on the macOS/arm64 development host.

Image sha256 e08db880837bb0d2a90e7d23528aeefc116423f3240e8fd09dac0ae45313cac6,
67108864 bytes. Byte-identical to an image built from the unmodified pin, and
byte-identical across two independent builds. verify-build reports valid=true.
Six of six QEMU/OVMF scenarios pass: nominal 1/2/4/8, ap-start-failure at 4,
reboot at 2. docs/running.md followed end-to-end from a clean directory.

No verification was added. The image carries one certified clause —
kernel_step: result > 0, all/incomplete/solver @ to_platform(x86_64-pc-uefi-smp-v1).
Every kernel subsystem in it is unverified hand-written Rust. T0 is NOT STARTED.

Three upstream obstacles found and recorded in docs/reproduction.md: forge's
kernel-image target only works with the working directory set to its own
compile-time workspace root; the acceptance harness could not find firmware
outside three Linux paths; the harness requires Python 3.10+ undeclared.

Image builds on both hosts and in the pinned container. The overlay in scripts/build-image.sh exists because forge resolves its platform directory and output path from its own compile-time workspace root, which was checked two ways rather than assumed.
